label: Discord + Trello + HubSpot
_note: Alternative multi-platform stack proving the gap is not Telegram/Notion-specific. Discord (chat) + Trello (tasks) + HubSpot (CRM), each a separate MCP server. sample_tools mirror each vendor's documented request schema; tool_count scales the per-server average. Sources in docs/references.md.

get_channel_messages.name: discord_get_channel_messages
get_channel_messages.description: Returns the messages for a channel. Returns an array of Message objects on success, newest first, with author, content, attachments, embeds, mentions, and timestamps.

channel_id.description: The id of the channel to read

limit.description: Max number of messages to return (1-100)

before.description: Get messages before this message id

after.description: Get messages after this message id

around.description: Get messages around this message id

create_message.name: discord_create_message
create_message.description: Post a message to a guild text or DM channel. Supports content, embeds, components, allowed_mentions, and message references for replies.

channel_id.description: The id of the channel to post to

message_reference.description: Include to make the message a reply

allowed_mentions.description: Controls which mentions are allowed to ping

tts.description: True if this is a TTS message

create_card.name: trello_create_card
create_card.description: Create a new card on a list. Requires idList; accepts name, desc, due, idMembers, idLabels, pos. Returns the full Card object including badges, cover, shortUrl, and board/list ids.

idList.description: The id of the list the card should be created in

due.description: A due date for the card (ISO 8601)

idMembers.description: Comma-separated list of member ids to add

idLabels.description: Comma-separated list of label ids to add

pos.description: The position of the card: top, bottom, or a positive float

get_list_cards.name: trello_get_list_cards
get_list_cards.description: List the cards in a list. Returns an array of full Card objects with badges, dateLastActivity, desc, due, idBoard, idList, labels, name, pos, shortUrl and url.

fields.description: all or a comma-separated list of card fields to return

update_object.name: hubspot_crm_update_object
update_object.description: Update the properties of a CRM object (contact, company, deal, ticket). PATCH semantics: only supplied properties change. Returns the full object with default and updated properties.

objectId.description: The record id, or a unique property value when idProperty is set

properties.description: Map of property internal names to new values (all values are strings)

idProperty.description: Optional unique property to use as the id lookup

search_objects.name: hubspot_crm_search_objects
search_objects.description: Search CRM records by property filters, returning matching records with the requested properties. Supports filter groups (OR of ANDs), sorting, and pagination.

objectType.description: The CRM object type to search

filterGroups.description: Groups of filters; groups are ORed, filters within a group are ANDed

limit.description: Max results per page, up to 200
